item.title: Diesel Price Forecast June 2026: CEF Data Signals a Decrease
item.description: The CEF daily basic fuel price shows an over-recovery of 78 c/l for diesel as Brent crude drops from $126 to $101. Here is what June 2026 could look like.

item.title: Petrol Price Increase June 2026: Why South Africans Pay More
item.description: Petrol prices are rising in June 2026 as fuel levy relief is halved and global crude oil prices stay high. Here is what is happening and why.
